items.heading: Kanda ti Nyama
details: Key ingredients: beef, peanut butter, tomato, chili, greens
Brown beef pieces with onion and tomato.
Stir in peanut butter and a little water to form a sauce.
Add chopped greens and chili, simmering until tender.
Serve the rich stew over rice or cassava.

items.heading: Gozo with Fish
details: Key ingredients: cassava flour, water, fish, tomato sauce
Whisk cassava flour into boiling water, stirring into a stiff dough.
Knead the dough smooth directly in the pot.
Simmer fish in a light tomato and onion sauce.
Serve the dough alongside the fish and sauce.
